IMPLEMENTATION NOTE the melee shape cannot express: a ChuChu spends most of its life as a flat puddle - it only becomes a target after the wake check, stands up (huse2tachi) inside 380 units, and collapses back to a puddle (tachi2huse) every time it is hit; it can be stunned (mahi) and then RE-FORMS (hukkatsu, 20 frames) unless killed while down.
